verdict.rationale: The pack only indirectly shows that Google Cloud resources live in named regions and zones. A user picked the wrong region for a committed-use purchase (comm-8), persistent SSDs were provisioned in us-west1-a (comm-10), and the status page reports per-region impact (comm-18). None of these items documents choosing where data is stored or any data-residency control. Missing for 10: first-party docs on region/location selection for data storage, data residency guarantees or controls (e.g. org policy location restrictions), coverage of where AI/Vertex data is stored, and independent corroboration.
